notes: Intent 158a1. New roadmap route, closing the gap that forced the 171 (consistency-dividend) roadmap handoff to be resumed by hand. Scopes: description triggering (1-3) and behavior/convention compliance (4-8), the latter checked against SKILL.md.

behavior.evidence: convention checks against skills/roadmap-continuing/SKILL.md and references/liveness-ranking.md

evals.prompt: resume the delivery batch we were shipping
where did that batch of intents land
evals.expected_output: Activates plastic-roadmap-continuing (indirect trigger: a roadmap-resume request that never names 'roadmap' or 'continue').

evals.prompt: Does the skill rank liveness correctly when a batch entry is delivering or blocked?
evals.expected_output: A roadmap with any delivering/blocked batch entry wins the ranking outright over every other candidate.

assertions.check: delivering/blocked-wins rule documented as step 2 of the algorithm

evals.prompt: Does the skill fall back to newest Log date when no candidate is delivering/blocked?
evals.expected_output: Among remaining candidates, the most recent ## Log entry timestamp wins.

evals.prompt: Does the skill present the roadmap state before asking?
evals.expected_output: The '## Present state' section (Goal, current batch, newest Log line) runs before the '## Ask once' section.

assertions.check: Present state precedes Ask once in document order

evals.prompt: Does the skill ask 'auto or guided?' exactly once?
evals.expected_output: Exactly one ask, after presenting state; never re-asked.

assertions.check: the literal phrase 'auto or guided' appears on exactly one line of SKILL.md

evals.prompt: Does the skill invent a new roadmap or INDEX status field, or add a new script?
evals.expected_output: No. Liveness is computed at read time from existing files; INDEX.md stays the sole status writer; the enumeration/ranking is prose, not a helper script.

assertions.check: no new field or script introduced; 'No new script' section present
